card.name: Final part of the word anticoagulant
card.fires_on: The last piece of the word anticoagulant (ANT or ulant) after the split-off start ANTICOAGUL, anticoag or anti-coag. It appears in anticoagulant solutions and in blood-draw tubes.

modes.label: Capitalized ANTICOAGULANT
modes.description: The ending ANT in all-caps anticoagulant solution names such as sodium citrate or citrate dextrose.
modes.example: DO NOT INFUSE SODIUM CITRATE 4% W/V ANTICOAGUL<<ANT>> SOLUTION USP DIRECTLY TO THE DON

modes.label: Lowercase anticoagulant
modes.description: The ending ulant after anticoag in running text about anticoagulant treatment or sample tubes.
modes.example: Administer anticoag<<ulant>> treatment as clinically indicated.

card.plain: It lights up on the ending of the word anticoagulant when that word is written in pieces.
